(event EventTick (DeltaSeconds)
  (if (Variables|Default|GetIsReady)
    (bind fc (Variables|Default|GetFiringComp))
    (if (Firing|Control|IsFiring fc)
      (switch Utilities|FlowControl|Switch|SwitchonEFiringModeType (Firing|Control|GetFiringMode fc)
        (:Bullet
          (CallFunction|HideBeam))
        (:TractorBeam
          (CallFunction|ShowBeam :Mat (Variables|Default|GetTractorMaterial) :Thickness (Variables|Default|GetTractorThickness) :ImpactSize (Variables|Default|GetTractorImpactSize) :EndPoint (CallFunction|ResolveEnd :Start (Transformation|GetWorldLocation (Variables|Default|GetMuzzle)) :Dir (Transformation|GetForwardVector fc) :HasTarget (Firing|TractorBeam|HasTractorTarget fc) :Target (Firing|TractorBeam|GetTractorTarget fc))))
        (:Scanner
          (CallFunction|ShowBeam :Mat (Variables|Default|GetScanMaterial) :Thickness (Variables|Default|GetScanThickness) :ImpactSize (Variables|Default|GetScanImpactSize) :EndPoint (CallFunction|ResolveEnd :Start (Transformation|GetWorldLocation (Variables|Default|GetMuzzle)) :Dir (Transformation|GetForwardVector fc) :HasTarget (Firing|Scanner|HasScanTarget fc) :Target (Firing|Scanner|GetScanTarget fc))))
        (:Custom
          (CallFunction|HideBeam)))
      (else
        (CallFunction|HideBeam)))))
